Delivered · 2026-11-25T18:35Z · PR #37332 merged; the card closed through `Fixes`. A create form's opening autofill (`options.opening`) is now written inside `openingFillInFlightRef`, so the dependent-lookup clear re-bases instead of acting. A related tab's New two `dependsOn` levels deep keeps its seeded parent pair, and a user's own edit of the upstream field still clears its dependents (CONTROL pinned in `form-dependent-lookup-clear-11631.test.tsx`). `pm:dispatched` removed; nothing remains on this card.
